title: Migration Chain Timeline
dataSources: Tree records (`genealogy:record`), DNA matches (`dna:match`), ancestor events (`ancestor:event`), archive documents (`archive:document`), tree nodes (`familytree:node`).
app: Genealogy and family-history research — tree platforms (Ancestry, FamilySearch), DNA match exports (23andMe, MyHeritage), and document / archive catalogues — streamed to Splunk HEC via GEDCOM and CSV exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ancestor:event event_type=migration
| sort 0 ancestor_id _time
| streamstats current=f last(location) as previous_location by ancestor_id
| where isnotnull(previous_location)
| stats count as moves by ancestor_id
description: Counts documented migration steps for each ancestor to show which life journeys are richly traced versus barely known.
value: Migration chains are central to family history storytelling and often reveal where the next record should exist.
implementation: Capture migration events with chronological location data and count sequential moves per ancestor.
visualization: Table of ancestors with documented migration move count.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks whose life journeys across places are well traced and whose are still patchy.
